title: School health assistants; compensation.
bodyText: All full-time school health assistants employed in the department shall be employed and have their compensation fixed in accordance with chapter 76 and the appropriate collective bargaining agreement, executive order, executive directive, or rule.
bodyHtml: §302A-854  School health assistants; compensation.  All full-time school health assistants employed in the department shall be employed and have their compensation fixed in accordance with chapter 76 and the appropriate collective bargaining agreement, executive order, executive directive, or rule. [L 2007, c 105, pt of §2; am L 2012, c 134, §3; am L 2023, c 173, §5]
